title: Practice: Rear Uppercut Elbow
source: Practice Mode tutorial. The owner's rear uppercut elbow. Words from the app's Technique Library (practiceData.js › Muay Thai › Rear Uppercut Elbow). Thai: Sok Ngat (ศอกงัด). Footage: the owner's clip 18 (ring, 2026-10-31), raw-footage/practice/p18.mp4, one shot, four reps with the rear elbow rising at about 0.8, 2.8, 4.7 and 6.6 s.

props.description: The rising elbow under the chin, rear side
props.hookSub: Rear uppercut elbow. Sok Ngat. 20 seconds.

cues.text: Drop the hand, point the elbow up
cues.label: DROP
cues.say: Coach: "The hand dips first, so the point of the elbow leads the way up."

cues.label: LEGS
cues.say: Coach: "The legs straighten into it. That's where the lift comes from."

cues.label: FINISH
cues.say: Coach: "Follow through until the hand is past your ear. Short of that, it's a nudge."

watch.label: SHOULDER
watch.say: Coach: "Shoulder only and it's an arm strike. Legs and hip, and it lifts their head."
